parsed.main_gap: Xiang's explicit refinement construction (the overlay realizing D ≤ Γ with at most q−1 cuts) is asserted as 'standard; details omitted'; the tight cut count is never verified.

errors.description: Upper-bound half of the refinement lemma: the overlay/common-refinement construction is only sketched, with the crucial verification that it uses at most q−1 cuts (it needs |B| cuts in the A-row including one at s_B, |A|−1 in the B-row, plus q−|A|−|B| bisections) omitted entirely. This is the constructive core of Xiang's strategy.
errors.quote: and use at most \(q-1\) cuts in total (standard; details omitted).

errors.description: The reduction 'deleting two equal entries from a sorted list does not change D' is stated rather than proved; it needs the observation that within a tie block the two copies can be taken adjacent and that repeated deletion keeps the list sorted. Correct but informal.
errors.quote: Deleting two equal entries from a sorted list does not change \(D\): the two copies may be adjacent within their tie block

parsed.notes: Answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) is consistent with an independent check at n=1,2. Drafting lemma and the graph/tree lower bound D ≥ Γ are correct and carefully done. Sections 5–6 are non-mathematical padding but harmless.
